# Third-party notices

The XA Mass Server Runtime contains third-party libraries inside the Spring
Boot executable JAR and optional Scenario Worker Host, plus the compiled
Runtime Viewer. Their
upstream licenses continue to apply.

- Spring Boot and the Spring ecosystem: Apache License 2.0.
- Google's libphonenumber and carrier metadata: Apache License 2.0.
- Pure Admin Thin: MIT License. Its preserved license is shipped as
  `LICENSE.pure-admin-thin` and its source notice as
  `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.frontend.md`.
- Scalar API Reference: MIT License. Its source notice is included in
  `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.frontend.md`.

This notice does not replace or broaden any license applicable to XA Mass
source code. The repository currently has no root project license file, so the
distribution deliberately does not present a third-party license as the XA
Mass project license.
